'''Tal'cara''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. It was an industrial center where most of the colony's population was concentrated.<ref name="guide" />
==Geography==
The city was built on a metallic platform (eight kilometers square) as its foundation. The platform functioned as a conductor, granting the city a warmer temperature than the rest of the continent (about five degrees).<ref name="guide" />

It was a busy city that was home to hundreds of corporations. [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[human/Legends|humans]] and other [[species/Legends|species]] crowding its streets; at nights it was brightly illuminated. The city however invited a lot of outcasts, fugitives and dishonored Bothans.<ref name="guide" /> 
[[File:TalcaraMap-SOTEPGp77.png|thumb|left|A map of the city]]
The city was "flanked" by an area of private villas in the west (with the [[Kothlis Starport]]) and by an area of apartment complexes in the east. Between them was an area surrounded by [["The Loop" (unirail)|"The Loop"]] [[Monorail/Legends|unirail]] circuit, which housed a market center and several corporations. To the north were some government buildings, including the [[Imperial compound (Kothlis)|Imperial compound]] and the [[Bothan police force]] station. To the south was the [[Warehouse district (Tal'cara)|Warehouse district]]; among its backways and alleys were several Spynet facilities and safehouses.<ref name="guide" /> 

The eastern sector was dedicated as apartment complex. It consisted of 200 elegant buildings of different designs; some had [[Fervse|glitterstone]] facades according to Bothan tradition. Each was 40 stories tall and each story had about 100 one-room studios, with some buildings also providing suites. The southernmost buildings belonged however to the seedy area of the warehouse district. A lot of residents waited long (especially those without good connection) to rent one of those room-apartments.<ref name="guide" /> 

The areas around the compound and the starport were the cleanest, best maintained and best guarded. In contrast, the warehouse district was the most dangerous.<ref name="guide" />

==History==
Kothlis was first owned by [[Raynor Mining Enterprises]]. The company imported [[Clan]]s of [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] as manual workers, who built the first installations on the planet: a temporary facility and a [[Abandoned smelting plant|smelting plant]] at the eastern feet of the [[Ragnook Mountains]]. Most of the millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] funded the construction of a huge [[metal/Legends|metallic]] platform near the production centers, in order to build a mega-city on it. The plans included an underground tunnel system for transportation.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> 

However when the platform was complete, with some support structures, the ore reserves unexpectedly ran out. The floundering led to Raynor's bankruptcy. This gave the Bothans the opportunity to purchase Kothlis and establish a colony (along with the constructions and the workers). After a [[standard month/Legends|month]] of political struggle, [[Clan Alya]], [[Clan Balya|Balya]] and [[Clan Ilya|Ilya]] were chosen to colonize the planet.<ref name="guide" />

However it was not soon when Tal'cara was completed. Kothlis had first to enjoy colonist waves and development before non-Bothan corporations settled on the planet. The Bothans then proceeded to intricate maneuvering, political and economic, to extract funds from them, and finish the construction.<ref name="guide" />

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], most of the colony's light industry was centered on Tal'cara. Elite [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] patrolled the streets on [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]], maintaining the Empire's visibility.<ref name="guide" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Havocs]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] sacked the city.

[[Maxeena Sov'lya]] was a local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime boss]] who ran protection rackets and smuggling in the city.<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>

{{City-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]'' includes a city map of Tal'cara that is inexplicably titled "'''Kla'taal'''." However, the name Kla'taal is not mentioned anywhere else within the text or in any other source material. This article therefore treats Kla'taal as synonymous with Tal'cara, possibly as a working title that was not changed before the text's final publication.
